subject: CWE-121
object: A stack-based buffer overflow condition is a condition where the buffer being overwritten is allocated on the stack (i.e., is a local variable or, rarely, a parameter to a function).
object_canonical: a stack-based buffer overflow condition is a condition where the buffer being overwritten is allocated on the stack (i.e., is a local variable or, rarely, a parameter to a function).

subject: CWE-787
object: The product writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.
